name: Project switcher
author: Brett
description: Separate workspaces: each project has its own builds, notes, to-dos, tasks, lists and plans, and a new one starts empty. AmberX AXF holds everything from before projects. Banner chip shows the active project; tap it, the app menu (Builds → Project), the right-click menu or Settings → Plugins → Projects to switch, start a new project, rename, archive or delete one (archive and delete ask you to type its id; the data stays on disk). Projects are framework data (framework/cli/projects.mjs, projects@1): removing this plugin leaves them and their data in place.

items.title: List projects
items.description: Every project with its build counts and which one is active (voice: 'what projects do I have').

items.title: Active project
items.description: The project the console, AmberX and every build list work on now (voice: 'which project am I in').

items.title: New project
items.description: Start a new project with its own builds, notes, to-dos, tasks, lists and plans and its hub home (/projects/<id>/, validated project.manifest.json), and switch to it (voice: 'create a project called Garden', 'new project called Garden with seed data'). Empty unless seed is demo (clearly marked test data). select false keeps the current one active. Runs without approval for the owner.

id.description: optional id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes (default: from the name)

repo.description: optional linked GitHub repository: owner/name or its URL

seed.description: demo = start with test data: nested lists, to-dos, notes, plans and sample builds ('with seed data'); default none

items.title: Switch project
items.description: Make another project the active one, for every device and session; open consoles follow at once (voice: 'switch to project AmberX AXF'). Running builds of other projects keep running. Runs without approval for the owner.

items.title: Rename a project
items.description: Change a project's name or description (voice: 'rename project garden to Garden Planner').

items.title: Archive a project
items.description: Take a project off the switcher; its data stays and its queued builds stop being dispatched. confirm must be the project id (tell Brett first). AmberX AXF can't be archived.

confirm.description: the project id, typed to confirm

items.title: Unarchive a project
items.description: Put an archived project back on the switcher (voice: 'bring back project garden').

items.title: axHub policy for projects is set
items.description: Brett has set axHub's tool policy so project_create and project_switch run at once (project_delete keeps Confirm); clears the systems check item (voice: 'the axHub policy for projects is set'). done false shows it again.

items.title: Delete a project
items.description: Take a project off the list for good; its data folders stay on disk (create a project with the same id to get it back). confirm must be the project id (tell Brett first). AmberX AXF can't be deleted.

confirm.description: the project id, typed to confirm
